scope.summary: Implement the Effect Gallery browser: single operator surface (deduped filter-gallery/effect-gallery) that applies/stacks the artistic families cumulatively as ordered gallery layers with per-effect previews, reorder, and show/hide, each becoming a StudioLiveFilter entry on commit. Available to raster + vector targets via the live-raster-effect path ([STU-FX-005]) governed by the document raster-effect resolution setting. Foreground/background-color-driven sub-effects preserved as typed parameters. Operator-visible surface with stable Argus author_ids + machine-readable state.
acceptance_criteria: Effect Gallery workspace applies/stacks artistic effects cumulatively (preview/reorder/show-hide) committing StudioLiveFilter entries; operator-visible + Argus
expected_tests: argus: Effect Gallery reachable with stable author_ids; cumulative stack with reorder/preview/show-hide
test: gallery layers commit as StudioLiveFilter entries; vector target uses raster-effect resolution setting

risk_if_missed: No gallery browser; artistic families lack their cumulative apply surface.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
